verdict.rationale: Airwallex's Banking-as-a-Service and connected accounts docs explicitly let developers programmatically create embedded accounts for their customers with multi-currency balances, global receiving accounts, and card issuing—without the developer needing their own banking license, since Airwallex holds the regulatory infrastructure. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on case study confirming a third-party platform successfully embedded this in production, and licensing/jurisdictional scope details are not fully spelled out.
